subject: general
question: Amit starts moving in the north direction from his initial position. Before reaching his final destination, he turns two times right and one time left and again one time right. In which direction is he moving now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information:

Amit starts moving in the north direction from his initial position.

Before reaching his final destination, he turns two times right and one time left and again one time right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f17446b742b7119b9c88dcabb20954d2f20652d708aebe0c628ccf8034ac7c0.png] 

So, he is moving in **south **direction now.

Hence, the correct answer is **"South".**
